parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1075126 (Pyruvate kinase PKLR). Join activities to assays and target_dictionary to filter by target ChEMBL ID. Join activities to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures to obtain molecule identifiers and canonical SMILES. Filter for standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL values. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit output to 1000 rows.
